newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 4.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 4.

text.p: These were the main headlines reported by Kuku Radio on Wednesday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- The Oru peat plant bankruptcy adminstrator has to pay wages by Friday for workers at the plant.
- The government wants to retain the right to determine tax benfits.
